verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents audit logs as a Server Pro feature, managed through a web console and listed on the pricing page, so the core logging capability exists, but only on the paid tier. The evidence does not say what the log records or whether it can be exported. Missing for 10: documentation that logs capture who connected to which machine and when, an audit export capability (e.g., CSV/API export), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
